WHO WE ARE
Building the Next Generation of Builders.
eSTEAMED Academy is a Sacramento-region STEAM education company serving youth ages 5–19. We run hands-on enrichment classes, competitive robotics and esports leagues, and school-based expanded learning programs — all designed around one idea: kids learn best when curiosity has somewhere to go.
We believe STEM shouldn't feel like homework. It should feel like a team you make the cut for, a build you can't wait to finish, and a season you're counting down to. That's why everything we do is built on the same principle that makes youth sports so powerful — practice, teams, seasons, and a place to show what you've built.
COPY NOTE: Founding story / year established / founder bio are not yet defined for this page. Flag as placeholder — recommend a short 'Our Story' paragraph once finalized (who started it, why, and what problem it solves for Sacramento-area families).

WHAT WE DO
Three Programs. One Mission.
eSTEAMED Academy operates three connected programs, each designed to meet kids and families where they are:
eSTEAMED Academy & Makerspace
Our in-person home base. Weekly enrichment classes in coding, game development, 3D printing, and AI, plus open Makers Mondays sessions where kids can build on their own projects using our tools and space.
eSTEAMED Labs & Leagues
Our competitive track. Seasonal robotics and esports teams — including VEX IQ robotics and our proprietary eSTEAMED STEAM Challenge League — that turn STEM skills into team sport. Kids practice, compete, and climb toward championship season, just like they would on a soccer or basketball team.
eSTEAMED Expanded Learning Academy
Our school partnership arm. We bring STEM enrichment, youth development, and esports programming directly into afterschool programs (ELOP) at partner districts across the Sacramento region.

Where Curiosity Meets Competition.

WHY ESTEAMED
Because STEM Shouldn't Be a One-Off. It Should Be a Season.
Plenty of places teach kids to code or build a robot for an hour a week. We built something different: a program where those skills carry forward into a team, a season, and a championship — the same structure that makes kids show up early for soccer practice, applied to STEAM.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
We're Not a Class. We're a League.
Most enrichment programs stop at the class. We don't. eSTEAMED is built around a Labs-to-Leagues pathway: kids start in a Makerspace class or Lab, build real skill, and then have somewhere to take it — a robotics team, an esports roster, or our own eSTEAMED STEAM Challenge League.
That means practice has a purpose. Every skill kids learn in a Lab session is something they'll use to compete, not just something they'll forget over the summer.
COPY NOTE: Consider adding a simple visual funnel graphic here (Class → Lab → Team → League) once Figma layout is set — flagged for Sersi/design, not copy.
The STEAM Challenge League — Nothing Else Like It
Our proprietary eSTEAMED STEAM Challenge League blends escape-room puzzles, engineering builds, and academic-decathlon-style challenges into a single competitive format. It's the kind of event families circle on the calendar — and right now, no one else in the region offers anything like it.
Real Competition, Real Structure
Team jerseys. Public standings. Championship events. A draft night. A parent-coach pipeline. We borrowed the parts of youth sports that actually work and applied them to robotics and esports — because kids don't get excited about worksheets, they get excited about making the team.

BUILT FOR EVERY AGE & STAGE
One Pathway, Ages 5 to 19.
Most programs age out at 12. We don't. eSTEAMED is built as a long runway — from a first Makers Monday session in elementary school, through VEX IQ and VEX V5 robotics, to leadership roles coaching younger teams as our older students grow into mentors.
COPY NOTE: Confirm whether we want to name a specific 'grow into mentors / student coach' pathway here, or hold that language for a future Leagues-specific page once that structure is built out.

ROOTED IN SACRAMENTO
Local, In-Person, and Connected to Your School Day.
We're not a national franchise running the same script in every city. eSTEAMED is built in and for the Sacramento region — with a physical Innovation Studio your kids can walk into, and direct partnerships with local school districts through our Expanded Learning programs.
That means the same STEAM curriculum your child sees at school can continue after the bell rings, without switching brands, platforms, or instructors.

GET IN EARLY
Founding Families Get to Shape What This Becomes.
We're opening enrollment before the doors do. Families who join now aren't just signing up for a class — they're founding members of the first STEAM league of its kind in Sacramento, with early access to teams, priority scheduling, and founding-family pricing.
